open_points.subject: FlowActivation (M18) / action timing for read-only flows
open_points.text: K-08: "A read-only flow is activated by the kernel once proven" vs Primary actions: "activate a flow | agent or owner asks; the kernel activates a proven read-only version at once"
open_points.question: For a proven read-only flow version, is a FlowActivation created automatically at compose/prove time, or only when the activate action is called?
options: Auto-activate immediately when proof succeeds (no explicit activate call needed)
Create activation only on explicit activate action (but kernel is actor for read-only)
open_points.default_guess: Auto-activate immediately on successful proof, with actor=kernel.

open_points.subject: ManifestOperation (M10) instance presence
open_points.text: M10: "each is absent when the installation selects no instance" vs K-16: "An installation selects one manifest instance per service"
open_points.question: Can an installation validly have no selected instance for a service, or must configuration always provide exactly one instance per service?
options: No omission allowed; missing instance is invalid configuration
Omission allowed; related ManifestOperation fields may be absent and operations become unusable
open_points.default_guess: No omission allowed; treat missing instance as configuration error.

open_points.subject: StandingGrant (M25) eligibility by effect class
open_points.text: K-08 approval stops are defined for `state-transition`, `external-effect`, `destructive`; Primary action only refuses grants for `destructive` or inactive version
open_points.question: Are standing grants allowed on `read`/`draft-write` operation nodes (which do not ask approval), or only on approval-gated classes?
options: Allow grants on any non-destructive operation node
Allow grants only on `state-transition` and `external-effect` nodes; refuse others

open_points.subject: EffectApproval (M24) multiplicity for one waiting effect
open_points.text: Owner decision 18: "Any difference at send ... asks again"; M24 defines statuses but no uniqueness/supersession rule for approvals of the same run/node/map_index/attempt
open_points.question: When a new approval is requested for the same effect point (due request change), what is the allowed cardinality and fate of prior approvals?
options: At most one open approval per effect point; prior one is closed/superseded
Multiple approvals may coexist; invoker selects only one matching request_digest
open_points.default_guess: Multiple may coexist; only an approval matching the exact request_digest is usable, older ones remain unused.
